title_en: Thomas Markle, Meghan’s father, jailed after cutting off ankle monitor, DoJ says
title_zh: 美国司法部称，梅根的父亲托马斯·马克尔因切断脚踝监视器而入狱
summary: Estranged father of Duchess of Sussex was arrested for keeping child sexual abuse material, authorities say The estranged father of Meghan Markle, the Duchess of Sussex, has been jailed after US authorities said he cut an electronic monitoring device off his a
summary_zh: 当局称，苏塞克斯公爵夫人的分居父亲因保存儿童性虐待材料而被捕。
body_en: Estranged father of Duchess of Sussex was arrested for keeping child sexual abuse material, authorities say

The estranged father of Meghan Markle, the Duchess of Sussex, has been jailed after US authorities said he cut an electronic monitoring device off his ankle, days after his arrest for keeping child sexual abuse material in storage units in California .

Thomas Markle, 82, was in custody awaiting a hearing in federal court in Tampa, Florida, first assistant US attorney Bill Essayli said. He was arrested shortly after he cut off the ankle bracelet at 1.45am on Tuesday, Essayli said.

“Release conditions are court orders, not suggestions. We are asking the court to revoke his release and detain him pending trial, and we will continue to prosecute this case to the fullest extent of the law,” Essayli said.
The US magistrate judge Lindsay Griffin agreed on Tuesday that Markle now must be kept in custody.

Markle’s arrest on Friday followed the seizure of approximately 78 items, including slides, film negatives and books that contained suspected child sexual abuse images in storage in the Los Angeles area, Essayli said.

Among the alleged child sexual abuse material were sexually explicit photographs of Markle with underage girls, including one taken in what appears to be part of a motel chain in the Philippines, Reuters reports.

According to the criminal complaint, the special agent investigating Markle’s alleged storage unit said he “viewed a collection of what appeared to be strips of 35mm film negatives seized from Storage Unit 1 registered to Markle”.
“To date, I have identified approximately 18 images that appeared to constitute child pornography,” the special agent noted in the complaint, adding that the investigation remains ongoing.
Markle reportedly had rented the storage units in Los Angeles since 2008, with the FBI noting that the most recent auto-payment for the units was on 14 October.

“Markle’s use of Storage Unit 1 was also corroborated by items found within the unit bearing his name, including boxes labeled ‘Tom Markle’ and an address within the central district of California,” the criminal complaint said.

During his arrest last week, he was taken from a senior care center in Lakeland, Florida, by ambulance. Hours later, a judge allowed Markle to be released on the condition that he be electronically monitored, which typically means wearing an ankle tether.
According to Griffin, Markle’s court appearance last Friday included a “lack of recall”. Griffin also cited Markle’s “health condition” and “advanced age” as part of his appearance.
The judge ordered a mental competency exam and a report by 20 November.

Griffin said she found “reasonable cause to believe” Markle was suffering from a condition “rendering him mentally incompetent to the extent that he is unable to understand the nature and consequences of the proceedings against him or to assist properly in his defense”, CBS reported .

His daughter, Meghan, the Duchess of Sussex , married Prince Harry at Windsor Castle in 2018. They have two children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet. She is an American citizen and actor who starred in the US television drama Suits.

Meghan recently said she was “deeply distressed” by allegations that a collection of child sexual abuse images had been found at her father’s former home. She also revealed that a letter containing “troubling allegations” about him had been sent to police in London in 2019.

“It made troubling and disturbing allegations against my father and I was given assurances that these were being investigated,” Meghan said of the letter. “I hope it can now be understood that, despite certain media publications’ distortion over the years, any distance from my father and my choice to not allow him to have contact with our children was for one reason: to protect them.”
Thomas Markle was living in the Philippines this year when he suffered a stroke and had his left leg amputated. That forced him to return to the US.
body_zh: 当局称，苏塞克斯公爵夫人分居的父亲因保存儿童性虐待材料而被捕
苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根·马克尔关系疏远的父亲因在加利福尼亚州的储藏室中存放儿童性虐待材料而被捕，几天后美国当局表示，他从脚踝上割下了一个电子监控装置，随后被判入狱。
美国首席检察官比尔·埃赛利 (Bill Essayli) 表示，82 岁的托马斯·马克尔 (Thomas Markle) 已被拘留，等待佛罗里达州坦帕联邦法院的听证会。 Essayli 说，他于周二凌晨 1 点 45 分切断脚链后不久被捕。
“释放条件是法院命令，而不是建议。我们要求法院撤销对他的释放，并将他拘留候审，我们将继续在法律允许的最大范围内起诉此案，”埃萨利说。
美国治安法官林赛·格里芬周二同意，马克尔现在必须被拘留。
Essayli 表示，马克尔于周五被捕，此前警方在洛杉矶地区查获了约 78 件物品，其中包括幻灯片、底片和书籍，其中包含涉嫌儿童性虐待的图像。
据路透社报道，在涉嫌儿童性虐待的材料中，有马克尔与未成年女孩的露骨性照片，其中一张似乎是在菲律宾一家连锁汽车旅馆的一部分拍摄的。
根据刑事起诉书，调查马克尔所谓存储单元的特工表示，他“查看了从登记在马克尔名下的 1 号存储单元中查获的一系列似乎是 35 毫米底片的东西”。
“迄今为止，我已识别出大约 18 张似乎构成儿童色情内容的图像，”特工在诉状中指出，并补充说调查仍在进行中。
据报道，马克尔自 2008 年以来一直在洛杉矶租用这些存储单元，联邦调查局指出，最近一次自动付款是在 10 月 14 日。
刑事起诉书称：“马克尔对 1 号存储单元的使用也得到了在存储单元内发现的印有他名字的物品的证实，其中包括标有‘汤姆·马克尔’的盒子和加州中部地区的地址。”
上周被捕期间，他被救护车从佛罗里达州莱克兰的一家高级护理中心带走。几小时后，法官允许马克尔获释，但条件是对他进行电子监控，这通常意味着要戴上脚踝绳。
格里芬表示，马克尔上周五出庭时表示“不记得”。格里芬还提到了马克尔的“健康状况”和“高龄”作为他外表的一部分。
法官下令在 11 月 20 日之前进行心理能力检查并出具报告。
据哥伦比亚广播公司报道，格里芬表示，她“有合理的理由相信”马克尔患有某种疾病，“使他精神上无行为能力，以至于他无法理解针对他的诉讼的性质和后果，也无法适当地协助他辩护”。
他的女儿苏塞克斯公爵夫人梅根于 2018 年在温莎城堡与哈里王子结婚。他们有两个孩子，阿奇王子和莉莉贝特公主。她是美国公民和演员，曾出演美国电视剧《金装律师》。
梅根最近表示，她对在她父亲的故居发现一系列儿童性虐待图片的指控感到“深感悲痛”。她还透露，一封包含有关他“令人不安的指控”的信已于 2019 年发送给伦敦警方。
梅根在谈到这封信时说：“这对我父亲提出了令人不安和不安的指控，我得到了这些指控正在接受调查的保证。” “我希望现在大家可以理解，尽管多年来某些媒体出版物歪曲事实，但我与父亲的任何距离以及我选择不允许他与我们的孩子接触的原因只有一个：保护他们。”
托马斯·马克尔今年住在菲律宾，突然中风，左腿被截肢。这迫使他返回美国。

title_en: Trump's crypto profits raise alarms for transparency advocates
title_zh: 特朗普的加密货币利润给透明度倡导者敲响了警钟
summary: President Trump has made nearly $3 billion while in office, most of it in crypto ventures. And to the alarm of transparency advocates, much of the president's money comes from foreign sources.
summary_zh: 特朗普总统在任期间赚了近 30 亿美元，其中大部分来自加密货币企业。令透明度倡导者感到震惊的是，许多预
body_en: Trump's crypto profits raise alarms for transparency advocates President Trump has made nearly $3 billion while in office, most of it in crypto ventures. And to the alarm of transparency advocates, much of the president's money comes from foreign sources.
President Trump has made nearly $3 billion while in office, most of it in crypto ventures. And to the alarm of transparency advocates, much of the president's money comes from foreign sources.

Nobody has made more money while in office in the U.S. than President Trump. Most of his earnings come from cryptocurrency. Researchers who spent months gathering examples of Trump's conflicts of interest are now calling on the future Democrat-run Congress to act. NPR's Rafael Nam reports.
RAFAEL NAM, BYLINE: Nearly $3 billion - that's how much President Trump and his family have made in his second term, according to Will Ragland at the left-leaning Center for American Progress.
WILL RAGLAND: I think you could probably combine all of the past presidents' income made during their time in office, and it wouldn't come close to what we're seeing here.

NAM: It starts with the memecoin. It's a type of cryptocurrency usually based on memes or internet jokes. Days before his inauguration, Trump launched his own memecoin. He made over $600 million, according to the president's own disclosures. In an effort to drum up demand, the president held a dinner last year for the top holders of the coin. Many of those guests were foreign. Ragland thinks he knows why.

RAGLAND: This is a way for foreign investors - foreign countries, in some instances - to try and get as much influence as they can and use that as leverage or deals that they want to make that are helpful to them.

NAM: The White House has denied it's peddling influence. Foreign entanglements are also front and center in the president's other main crypto venture. It's called World Liberty Financial. And it's earned him and his family $1.4 billion for a company that's just over 2 years old, according to the researchers who spoke with NPR. Here's Virginia Canter of the anti-corruption group Democracy Defenders Fund.
VIRGINIA CANTER: How many individuals are there in America who made $1.4 billion in a business that they just got into?

NAM: Canter says there are several troubling foreign investments in World Liberty. A member of the United Arab Emirates royal family known as Sheikh Tahnoon invested half $1 billion into World Liberty, as first reported by The Wall Street Journal. It was an extraordinary show of confidence in a new company that had been struggling to gain acceptance. Months later, the UAE got something it had been lobbying for - a shipment of advanced AI chips from the U.S., giving the kingdom a big boost in its ambition to become an AI power. Canter wants to know why.

CANTER: And I think Congress would be on the strongest grounds, based on what's in the Constitution, to investigate what was involved and what was the motivation behind their initial $500 million investment in World Liberty.

NAM: World Liberty Financial declined to comment, while the Trump administration has denied any quid pro quo. But other deals made by World Liberty and foreign investors followed. There were additional deals made with Sheikh Tahnoon. There was also a deal by a company affiliated with World Liberty Financial with the government of Pakistan. In an interview with CBS' "60 Minutes," the president denied he knows much about World Liberty or his other business ventures.

PRESIDENT DONALD TRUMP: Well, let me explain. I devote almost no time to my net worth. I don't care. I make - I have a lot of money and far more than I ever thought I'd have. And I guess it's gone up.
NAM: But Democrats in Congress are signaling they care. Shortly after the election, the top Democrat on the House Oversight Committee, Robert Garcia, posted a message on social media - lawyer up.

特朗普总统在任期间赚了近 30 亿美元，其中大部分来自加密货币企业。令透明倡导者警惕的是，总统的大部分资金都来自外国。
在美国，没有人比特朗普总统在任期间赚的钱更多。他的大部分收入来自加密货币。研究人员花了几个月的时间收集特朗普利益冲突的例子，现在呼吁未来的民主党控制的国会采取行动。 NPR 的拉斐尔·南 (Rafael Nam) 报道。
拉斐尔·南连线：据左倾美国进步中心的威尔·拉格兰称，近 30 亿美元是特朗普总统及其家人在第二个任期内赚到的钱。
威尔·拉格兰：我认为你可以将历任总统在任期间的所有收入合并起来，但它不会接近我们在这里看到的收入。
NAM：首先是模因币。它是一种通常基于模因或网络笑话的加密货币。就职典礼前几天，特朗普推出了自己的模因币。根据总统自己的披露，他的收入超过 6 亿美元。为了刺激需求，总统去年为硬币的顶级持有者举办了晚宴。其中许多客人都是外国人。拉格兰认为他知道原因。
拉格兰：这是外国投资者（在某些情况下是外国投资者）尝试获得尽可能多的影响力并将其用作杠杆或他们想要进行的对他们有帮助的交易的一种方式。
NAM：白宫否认其兜售影响力。外国纠葛也是总统另一项主要加密货币事业的前沿和中心。它被称为世界自由金融。据接受 NPR 采访的研究人员称，这家成立仅 2 年多的公司为他和他的家人赚取了 14 亿美元。这是反腐败组织民主捍卫者基金会的弗吉尼亚·坎特的报道。
VIRGINIA CANTER：在美国有多少人在他们刚刚涉足的行业中赚到了 14 亿美元？
NAM：坎特表示，世界自由公司有几项令人不安的外国投资。据《华尔街日报》首先报道，阿拉伯联合酋长国王室成员 Sheikh Tahnoon 向 World Liberty 投资了 10 亿美元。这是对一家一直在努力获得认可的新公司的非凡信心。几个月后，阿联酋得到了一直在游说的东西——从美国运来的一批先进人工智能芯片，极大地推动了该国成为人工智能强国的雄心。坎特想知道原因。
坎特：我认为国会将有最有力的理由，根据宪法的规定，调查所涉及的内容以及他们对世界自由组织最初的 5 亿美元投资背后的动机是什么。
NAM：世界自由金融公司拒绝置评，而特朗普政府则否认有任何交换条件。但世界自由组织和外国投资者随后达成了其他交易。与谢赫塔努 (Sheikh Tahnoon) 达成了其他协议。世界自由金融集团旗下的一家公司也与巴基斯坦政府达成了一项协议。在接受哥伦比亚广播公司“60 分钟”节目采访时，总统否认他对世界自由组织或他的其他商业企业了解很多。
唐纳德·特朗普总统：好吧，让我解释一下。我几乎没有花时间在我的净资产上。我不在乎。我赚了——我有很多钱，而且比我想象的要多得多。我猜它已经上涨了。
NAM：但国会中的民主党人表示他们很关心。大选结束后不久，众议院监督委员会民主党高层罗伯特·加西亚在社交媒体上发布了一条消息——律师起来。

title_en: Senate Republicans vote to keep Thune as leader after election wipeout
title_zh: 选举失败后，参议院共和党人投票决定让图恩继续担任领导人
summary: Senate Republicans vented their frustrations in three separate meetings on Tuesday after an election wipeout that cost them at least seven Senate seats.
summary_zh: 参议院共和党人在选举惨败并损失至少七个参议院席位后，在周二的三次独立会议上发泄了他们的不满
body_en: Mary Clare Jalonick, Associated Press Mary Clare Jalonick, Associated Press
Steven Sloan, Associated Press Steven Sloan, Associated Press
https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/senate-republicans-vote-to-keep-thune-as-leader-after-election-wipeout

WASHINGTON (AP) — Senate Republicans reelected South Dakota Sen. John Thune as leader of the GOP conference after a tense day of discussions about steep losses in the midterm elections that cost them their majority.

Thune was always expected to prevail, as he is popular with his GOP colleagues and was running unopposed in the secret ballot election. But Senate Republicans vented their frustrations in three separate meetings on Tuesday after an election wipeout that cost them at least seven Senate seats.

Some Republicans had tried to delay the leadership decision, but the conference voted to proceed, said Wisconsin Sen. Ron Johnson, who had pushed to postpone. He walked out of the room as the voting began.
West Virginia Sen. Jim Justice said after the first meeting that "we want to be thoughtful and do the right thing."
Justice said there was a "legitimate argument that, good gracious, if we lost as badly as we lost, why would we continue on with the same leadership?"
At the same time, the current GOP leadership "didn't cause this problem to happen," Justice said. "They do a good job."

The angst — and the indecision — comes as frustrated Republicans are just beginning to reckon with what the election results mean for their future. Two additional Senate races remain uncalled in Alaska and Mississippi that could further deplete their numbers.
Several senators had already called on Republican leadership to delay the elections, which include contests for other party leaders as well and are held in the small Old Senate Chamber.
Missouri Sen. Josh Hawley said he isn't aware of anyone else running for leader, but "maybe there would be" if they waited.

"I just think that we've got a lot of things that we've got to think through, and I think that to just rush into this and just ratify all of the same leadership, what message does that send?" Hawley told reporters after walking out.
"If you don't think after losing seven Senate seats minimum that we need to change course, I don't know what planet you're on," he said.

Thune, who replaced Sen. Mitch McConnell of Kentucky as leader in early 2025, said before the meeting that they would have a "very fulsome, robust conversation about where we go from here and then we'll see what the consensus of the conference is."
Hawley said the discussion was a "frank" and "honest" open microphone meeting and some senators discussed their own races this year — some who won, and some who lost.
Republicans in the meeting were also pushing Thune to stay in session around the clock in the coming weeks to push through war spending and other party priorities before they lose power.
"We need a plan to get the Republican agenda done," said Florida Sen. Rick Scott.

Before the meeting, Johnson, the Wisconsin senator, had circulated a letter asking for the delay. He said the conference needs to do some "real soul-searching" but conceded that there's no one else on the ballot.
body_zh: 玛丽·克莱尔·贾洛尼克（美联社） 玛丽·克莱尔·贾洛尼克（美联社）
史蒂文·斯隆，美联社 史蒂文·斯隆，美联社
华盛顿（美联社）——参议院共和党人在为期一天的紧张讨论中再次选举南达科他州参议员约翰·图恩（John Thune）为共和党会议领袖，他们在中期选举中惨败，失去了多数席位。
图恩一直被认为会获胜，因为他深受共和党同事的欢迎，并且在无记名投票选举中没有遭到反对。但参议院共和党人在选举惨败并损失至少七个参议院席位后，在周二的三场独立会议上发泄了他们的不满。
曾推动推迟的威斯康星州参议员罗恩·约翰逊表示，一些共和党人曾试图推迟领导层决定，但会议投票决定继续进行。投票开始时，他走出房间。
西弗吉尼亚州参议员吉姆·贾斯蒂斯在第一次会议后表示，“我们希望深思熟虑并做正确的事情。”
贾斯蒂斯说，有一个“合理的论点，天哪，如果我们输得和我们输得一样惨，我们为什么还要继续保持同样的领导力呢？”
与此同时，现任共和党领导层“并没有导致这个问题的发生”，贾斯蒂斯说。 “他们做得很好。”
焦虑和犹豫不决之际，沮丧的共和党人刚刚开始考虑选举结果对他们的未来意味着什么。阿拉斯加和密西西比州的另外两场参议员竞选仍未召集，这可能会进一步耗尽他们的人数。
几位参议员已经呼吁共和党领导层推迟选举，其中还包括其他党派领导人的竞选，并在狭小的旧参议院会议厅举行。
密苏里州参议员乔什·霍利表示，他不知道还有其他人竞选领导人，但如果他们等待的话，“也许会有”。
“我只是认为我们有很多事情需要考虑清楚，我认为仓促地批准所有相同的领导层，这会发出什么信息？”霍利走出去后告诉记者。
“如果你在失去至少七个参议院席位后不认为我们需要改变路线，我不知道你在哪个星球上，”他说。
图恩于 2025 年初接替肯塔基州参议员米奇·麦康奈尔 (Mitch McConnell) 成为领导人，他在会议前表示，他们将“就我们下一步的发展方向进行一次非常充实、有力的对话，然后我们将看看会议达成的共识是什么。”
霍利表示，这次讨论是一次“坦率”和“诚实”的公开麦克风会议，一些参议员讨论了他们今年的竞选——一些获胜，一些失败。
与会的共和党人还敦促图恩在未来几周内全天候开会，以便在失去权力之前推动战争支出和其他党派优先事项。
“我们需要一项计划来完成共和党的议程，”佛罗里达州参议员里克·斯科特说。
会议之前，威斯康星州参议员约翰逊散发了一封信，要求推迟会议。他表示，会议需要进行一些“真正的反省”，但他承认投票中没有其他人。

title_en: FDA warns of rare eye condition causing blindness from GLP-1 weight loss medications
title_zh: FDA 警告 GLP-1 减肥药物可能导致罕见眼部疾病导致失明
summary: The federal agency is requiring all GLP-1s to include information about the potential risk on warning labels The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has issued a new warning on GLP-1 medications – which can facilitate weight loss – over a rare eye condition
summary_zh: 联邦机构要求所有 GLP-1 在警告标签上包含有关潜在风险的信息 美国食品和药物管理局 (FDA)
body_en: The federal agency is requiring all GLP-1s to include information about the potential risk on warning labels

The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has issued a new warning on GLP-1 medications – which can facilitate weight loss – over a rare eye condition that could lead to sudden and permanent blindness .

On Monday, the FDA announced that it is requiring all GLP-1 medications – including Novo Nordisk’s Ozempic and Wegovy, Eli Lilly’s Mounjaro and Zepbound, as well as Sanofi’s Soliqua – to include information about the potential risk of nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy, also known as NAION, on warning labels.

NAION is a rare condition involving sudden reduction of blood flow to the optic nerve, in turn resulting in acute, painless, decreased vision in one eye, including permanent vision loss, the FDA warned.

Common risk factors of NAION include diabetes, smoking, hypertension, as well as hypercholesterolemia. It is the most common cause of acute optic nerve injury in individuals over 50 years old, with an annual average of 2.3 to 10.2 cases out of 100,000 people above that age. There is for now no treatment to reverse vision loss from NAION.

According to the FDA, the agency began looking at potential links between GLP-1s and NAION after a 2024 study published in the journal JAMA Ophthalmology. The study found an increased risk of NAION among patients using GLP-1 medications.
Despite identifying several limitations of the study, the FDA said it “determined that further assessment of the potential increased risk for NAION was warranted”.

The agency proceeded to review 126 clinical trials involving over 134,200 patients and identified 15 probable NAION cases, including 10 among GLP-1 patients; five in patients receiving placebo; and none in patients who were on glucose-lowering medications that were not GLP-1.
The FDA found a NAION incidence rate of 6.4 cases per 100,000 person-years among GLP-1 patients, compared to 3.8 cases among patients on placebo or alternative glucose-lowering medications.
“NAION cases have been reported for all currently marketed GLP-1 RA products,” the FDA said. “FDA concluded that there is a potential increased risk of rare NAION events in patients taking GLP-1 RAs.
“Based on these findings, FDA is requiring that application holders add information about the risk for NAION to the Warnings and Precautions section of labeling of all GLP-1 RAs.”

In response to the FDA announcement, a Novo Nordisk spokesperson told the Guardian that the pharmaceutical company “continues to believe the data do not establish a cause-and-effect relationship and we remain confident in the benefit-risk profile of our GLP-1 medicines.”
The statement also said: “Patient safety is a top priority for Novo, and we continue to monitor the safety of our medicines, review new research and work with health authorities around the world.”
The Guardian has reached out to Eli Lilly and Sanofi for additional comment. Eli Lilly had previously said it is aware of publications on the risk of NAION among GLP-1 patients.

GLP-1 medications are mainly used by people with type 2 diabetes managing their blood sugar – or glucose – levels. Some of the medications are also used to help treat obesity. And some have been known to seek access to such drugs for cosmetic reasons rather than legitimate medical ones.

The FDA’s announcement comes amid warnings from the Netherlands-based non-profit Access to Medicine Foundation that the pharmaceutical focus on GLP-1 weight-loss drugs risks putting global insulin supply at risk.
body_zh: 联邦机构要求所有 GLP-1 在警告标签上包含有关潜在风险的信息
美国食品和药物管理局 (FDA) 针对一种可能导致突然和永久失明的罕见眼部疾病，对可促进减肥的 GLP-1 药物发出了新警告。
周一，FDA 宣布要求所有 GLP-1 药物——包括诺和诺德的 Ozempic 和 Wegovy、礼来的 Mounjaro 和 Zepbound，以及赛诺菲的 Soliqua——在警告标签上包含有关非动脉炎性前部缺血性视神经病变（也称为 NAION）潜在风险的信息。
FDA 警告说，NAION 是一种罕见疾病，涉及视神经血流量突然减少，进而导致一只眼睛的急性、无痛视力下降，包括永久性视力丧失。
NAION 的常见危险因素包括糖尿病、吸烟、高血压以及高胆固醇血症。它是 50 岁以上人群急性视神经损伤的最常见原因，每年平均每 10 万名该年龄以上人群中有 2.3 至 10.2 例。目前尚无治疗方法可以逆转 NAION 造成的视力丧失。
FDA 表示，在《JAMA 眼科》杂志上发表 2024 年的一项研究后，该机构开始研究 GLP-1 和 NAION 之间的潜在联系。研究发现使用 GLP-1 药物的患者发生 NAION 的风险增加。
尽管发现了该研究的一些局限性，FDA 表示“确定有必要进一步评估 NAION 潜在增加的风险”。
该机构继续审查了涉及超过 134,200 名患者的 126 项临床试验，并确定了 15 例可能的 NAION 病例，其中 10 例为 GLP-1 患者；接受安慰剂的患者中有 5 名；服用非 GLP-1 降糖药物的患者也没有出现这种情况。
FDA 发现 GLP-1 患者中 NAION 发病率为每 10 万人年 6.4 例，而服用安慰剂或替代降糖药物的患者中，NAION 发病率为 3.8 例。
FDA 表示：“目前所有上市的 GLP-1 RA 产品均已报告 NAION 病例。” “FDA 得出的结论是，服用 GLP-1 RA 的患者发生罕见 NAION 事件的风险可能会增加。
“根据这些发现，FDA 要求申请持有人将有关 NAION 风险的信息添加到所有 GLP-1 RA 标签的警告和注意事项部分。”
针对 FDA 的声明，诺和诺德发言人告诉《卫报》，该制药公司“仍然认为这些数据并未建立因果关系，我们对 GLP-1 药物的获益风险状况仍然充满信心。”
声明还表示：“患者安全是 Novo 的首要任务，我们将继续监控我们药品的安全性，审查新研究并与世界各地的卫生当局合作。”
《卫报》已联系礼来公司和赛诺菲征求更多评论。礼来公司此前曾表示，其已获悉有关 GLP-1 患者发生 NAION 风险的出版物。
GLP-1 药物主要供 2 型糖尿病患者用来控制血糖水平。有些药物还用于帮助治疗肥胖症。众所周知，有些人出于美容原因而不是合法的医疗原因寻求获得此类药物。
FDA 宣布这一消息之际，总部位于荷兰的非营利组织 Access to Medicine Foundation 发出警告，称制药公司专注于 GLP-1 减肥药物可能会使全球胰岛素供应面临风险。

title_zh: 家长提起诉讼，要求阻止华盛顿州的跨性别运动禁令，该禁令可能需要“侵入性”生殖器检查

summary_zh: 选民采取了极端政策，要求对所有想要参加团队运动的女孩进行医学性别验证 华盛顿学生运动员的家长
body_en: Parents sue to stop Washington state trans sports ban that could require ‘invasive’ genital exams | Washington state
Voters adopted extreme policy requiring medical sex verification for all girls who want to play team sports

Parents of student athletes in Washington state have sued to block a ballot initiative banning transgender girls from women’s sports teams, calling the measure discriminatory and warning it would lead to “invasive” genital examinations for female athletes.

Last week, voters in the solidly Democratic state passed Initiative 638 , a major setback for LGBTQ+ rights amid the “blue wave” of the US midterm elections. Nebraska, Colorado and Arizona adopted similar anti-trans sports bans, though advocates say Washington state’s policy is particularly extreme due to its medical sex verification requirement for all girls who want to play team sports.

The lawsuit was filed in state court on Monday by parents of trans and cisgender girls; TransFamilies, a non-profit Washington advocacy group; and the Washington Education Association, the teachers’ union. They are represented by the American Civil Liberties Union of Washington; Legal Voice, a group that fights gender discrimination; and Pacifica Law Group, a local firm.
‘The blue wave isn’t applicable to trans people’: advocates in Washington state prepare to fight ban

Washington’s measure mandates that girls provide documentation from medical providers about their sex before they join women’s teams, either through hormone or genetic tests or examinations of their “reproductive anatomy”. The policy does not apply to boys.

Doctors, teachers and parents have raised alarms about the potential of forcing girls to undergo genital exams, saying the enforcement mechanism was a severe privacy violation and would discourage all girls from joining sports. Proponents argue that the ban, funded by Brian Heywood , a conservative hedge fund manager, protects “fairness” in girls’ sports.

The law applies to students in elementary, middle and high school. School officials said earlier this year that they were aware of only about 10 trans sports players statewide, a tiny fraction of the state’s 200,000 student athletes.

The suit argues that the measure violates Washington’s constitution, including by infringing on students’ privacy and violating equal rights protections by only applying to girls. The ban also violates an anti-discrimination law that protects trans people, the suit says.

Tiffani Lennon, executive director of Legal Voice, noted that Washington state has for 20 years allowed trans youth to play on teams that match their gender: “This is a fabricated issue being manufactured to create alarm. They’re intending to send a message to trans youth that we don’t want you visible, and they are willing to put in place really extreme measures to ensure that it terrifies enough people to go run and hide.”

The plaintiffs include a parent of a 17-year-old trans girl who participates in team sports at her high school and who fears being outed and kicked out of athletics under the measure. Parents of two cisgender female athletes also joined the suit, saying they oppose the “intrusive” sex verification requirements.
“If you really want fairness in sports, why would you subject girls to sex verification? Why would you dissuade girls from participating in sports?” said Lennon. “It’s clearly discriminatory.”
On Monday, the Seattle public schools board of directors also voted in favor of allowing the district to take legal action against the ban, which is due to go into effect on 3 December.
body_zh: 家长提起诉讼，要求阻止华盛顿州的跨性别运动禁令，该禁令可能需要“侵入性”生殖器检查 |华盛顿州
选民采取了极端政策，要求所有想要参加团队运动的女孩进行医学性别验证
华盛顿州学生运动员的家长提起诉讼，阻止一项禁止跨性别女孩参加女子运动队的投票动议，称该措施具有歧视性，并警告称这将导致对女运动员进行“侵入性”生殖器检查。
上周，这个坚定的民主党州的选民通过了638号倡议，这是美国中期选举“蓝色浪潮”中LGBTQ+权利的重大挫折。内布拉斯加州、科罗拉多州和亚利桑那州也采取了类似的反跨性别运动禁令，但倡导者表示，华盛顿州的政策尤其极端，因为该州对所有想要参加团队运动的女孩都要求进行医学性别验证。
周一，跨性别女孩和顺性别女孩的父母向州法院提起了诉讼。 TransFamilies，华盛顿非营利性倡导组织；以及华盛顿教育协会、教师工会。他们的代表是华盛顿美国公民自由联盟；法律之声，一个反对性别歧视的团体；以及本地律师事务所 Pacifica Law Group。
“蓝色浪潮不适用于跨性别者”：华盛顿州的倡导者准备反对禁令
华盛顿的措施要求女孩在加入女子队伍之前，通过激素或基因测试或“生殖解剖学”检查，向医疗服务提供者提供有关其性别的文件。该政策不适用于男孩。
医生、教师和家长对强迫女孩接受生殖器检查的可能性提出了警告，称这种执行机制严重侵犯隐私，并会阻碍所有女孩参加体育运动。支持者认为，这项由保守派对冲基金经理布莱恩·海伍德资助的禁令保护了女子运动的“公平性”。
该法适用于小学、初中和高中学生。学校官员今年早些时候表示，他们只知道全州有大约 10 名跨性别运动员，仅占该州 20 万名学生运动员的一小部分。
该诉讼称，该措施违反了华盛顿宪法，包括侵犯学生的隐私，并仅适用于女孩，从而违反了平等权利保护。诉讼称，该禁令还违反了保护跨性别者的反歧视法。
法律之声执行董事蒂法尼·列侬 (Tiffani Lennon) 指出，华盛顿州 20 年来一直允许跨性别青少年参加与其性别相匹配的球队：“这是一个捏造的问题，旨在引起恐慌。他们想向跨性别青少年传达这样一个信息：我们不希望你出现在人们的视线中，他们愿意采取非常极端的措施，以确保有足够多的人因此而逃跑和躲藏起来。”
原告包括一名 17 岁跨性别女孩的家长，她在高中参加团队运动，她担心根据这项措施会被淘汰并被踢出田径运动。两名顺性别女运动员的父母也加入了诉讼，称他们反对“侵入性”的性别验证要求。
“如果你真的想要体育公平，为什么要对女孩进行性别验证？为什么要劝阻女孩参加体育运动？”列侬说。 “这显然是歧视性的。”
周一，西雅图公立学校董事会也投票赞成允许学区针对该禁令采取法律行动，该禁令将于 12 月 3 日生效。

title_en: Dreams, desks and selfies: Newly elected members of Congress learn their way around
title_zh: 梦想、办公桌和自拍照：新当选的国会议员学习如何解决问题
summary: More than 100 newly elected members of Congress are arriving in Washington this week for the start of freshmen orientation
summary_zh: 100 多名新当选的国会议员本周抵达华盛顿，开始新生迎新活动
body_en: More than 100 newly elected members of Congress are arriving in Washington this week for the start of freshmen orientation
By LISA MASCARO AP congressional correspondent

WASHINGTON -- Rep.-elect LaKesha Womack, a community organizer who stunned her own Democratic Party by defeating a well-know North Carolina Republican on her shoestring $56,000 campaign budget, said she's excited to arrive in Washington and show what's possible.
Rep.-elect Brian Poindexter said his win over incumbent GOP Rep. Max Miller ensures Ohio remains a very swing state.

And Rebecca Bennett, a former Navy helicopter pilot in New Jersey who said she's spent her whole life “trying to find the biggest, hardest problem to throw myself at,” was ready to give Congress a try. “There's always the unknown.”

They were among more than 100 newly elected members of Congress arriving in Washington this week for the start of freshmen orientation — the crush of new Democrats, many bringing a new sense of urgency after the party's sweep of the midterm elections , and the slim new class of freshmen Republicans.
“People were just looking for somebody who’s going to listen to them,” said Womack, who said she won by simply showing up and talking with voters.

“I’m a single mom and so I know what it’s like to have to live on a budget and figure out how am I going to feed my family,” she said. “And that’s what people want to fight for them in Washington right now.”

New-member orientation creates an unusual mash-up on Capitol Hill, as the newcomers are arriving and the exiting lawmakers begin to clear out, all in preparation for the peaceful transfer of power on Jan. 3, when lawmakers are sworn in and the new Congress begins.

This week’s orientation includes training sessions and ritzy receptions for the newcomers, and for the defeated or retirees it's the start of figuring out what’s next. Briefing rooms are filled with information about office set up, payroll and benefits, and there's a room to take officials portraits.
It’s also the time for the House and Senate to hold internal party elections for their new leaders, ahead of a public vote in January for the speaker of the House.

“I’m looking forward to learning as much as I can and being the best representative I can be for my district," said Poindexter as he arrived at the nearby Navy Yard hotel where lawmakers are temporarily housed.
The Capitol was a changed place as the members-elect started meeting up with their colleagues and getting to know their way around the place.
Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed of Michigan was swarmed by young people in the Capitol basement, taking pictures with the progressive star who is also the first Muslim in the Senate.

Texas Sen.-elect James Talarico paid a visit to the outgoing Texas Republican Sen. John Cornyn, who lost his own primary for reelection when President Donald Trump backed his rival, Ken Paxton, who was defeated.

“I’m so grateful for his advice and his guidance as I try to fill his big shoes,” Talarico said of Cornyn as he walked through the Senate between orientation events. He said he wants to meet with Republican Sen. Ted Cruz of Texas as well.
And Sen.-elect Juliana Stratton of Illinois snapped a photo with new Democratic senators-elect including Talarico, El-Sayed, Annie Andrews , Roy Cooper , Peggy Flanagan , Josh Turek and others.
“First Freshmen Senator selfie! Couldn’t ask for a better team,” she posted as the caption.
body_zh: 100 多名新当选的国会议员本周抵达华盛顿，开始新生迎新活动
美联社国会记者 LISA MASCARO
华盛顿——当选众议员拉克莎·沃马克（LaKesha Womack）是一名社区组织者，她以微薄的 56,000 美元竞选预算击败了一位著名的北卡罗来纳州共和党人，震惊了她所在的民主党。她说，她很高兴抵达华盛顿并展示一切的可能性。
当选众议员布莱恩·波因德克斯特表示，他对现任共和党众议员马克斯·米勒的胜利确保了俄亥俄州仍然是一个非常摇摆的州。
新泽西州前海军直升机飞行员丽贝卡·贝内特 (Rebecca Bennett) 表示，她一生都在“试图找到最大、最难的问题来解决”，她准备向国会一试。 “总有未知的事。”
他们是本周抵达华盛顿参加新生迎新活动的 100 多名新当选国会议员中的一员——新民主党人的热情，许多人在该党在中期选举中大获全胜后带来了新的紧迫感，还有人数不多的新生共和党人。
沃马克说：“人们只是在寻找愿意倾听他们意见的人。”她说，她只是通过出现并与选民交谈而获胜。
“我是一名单亲妈妈，所以我知道必须靠预算生活并弄清楚如何养活家人是什么感觉，”她说。 “这就是人们现在想要在华盛顿为他们而战的目标。”
新议员迎新活动在国会山上造成了一场不同寻常的混搭，新议员陆续抵达，而现任议员则开始撤离，这一切都是为了 1 月 3 日议员们宣誓就职和新一届国会开始时和平移交权力做准备。
本周的迎新活动包括为新人提供培训课程和豪华招待会，而对于失败者或退休者来说，这是弄清楚下一步要做什么的开始。简报室里充满了有关办公室设置、工资和福利的信息，还有一个房间可以拍摄官员的肖像。
这也是众议院和参议院在 1 月份公众投票选举众议院议长之前举行党内新领导人选举的时候。
“我期待尽可能多地学习，并成为我所在选区的最佳代表，”波因德克斯特抵达附近立法者临时居住的海军造船厂酒店时说道。
随着当选议员开始与同事会面并熟悉这里的情况，国会大厦发生了变化。
密歇根州当选参议员阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德在国会大厦地下室被年轻人包围，与这位进步明星、参议院第一位穆斯林一起合影。
德克萨斯州当选参议员詹姆斯·塔拉里科拜访了即将卸任的德克萨斯州共和党参议员约翰·科宁。由于唐纳德·特朗普总统支持他的竞争对手肯·帕克斯顿，后者在竞选连任中落败，科宁失去了自己的连任初选。
“当我试图接替他的位置时，我非常感谢他的建议和指导，”塔拉里科在迎新活动间隙穿过参议院时谈到科宁时说道。他说他还想会见德克萨斯州共和党参议员特德·克鲁兹。
伊利诺伊州当选参议员朱莉安娜·斯特拉顿 (Juliana Stratton) 与新当选的民主党参议员合影，其中包括塔拉里科 (Talarico)、埃尔-赛义德 (El-Sayed)、安妮·安德鲁斯 (Annie Andrews)、罗伊·库珀 (Roy Cooper)、佩吉·弗拉纳根 (Peggy Flanagan)、乔什·图雷克 (Josh Turek) 等人。
“第一张新生参议员自拍照！找不到比这更好的团队了，”她在标题中写道。

title_en: House Republicans urge DoJ to further investigate ‘key witnesses’ in Epstein case
title_zh: 众议院共和党人敦促司法部进一步调查爱泼斯坦案的“关键证人”
summary: Republicans on House panel criticize US government’s investigation into Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell Republicans on the House oversight committee released a report on Tuesday criticizing the federal government’s handling of the investigations into Jef
summary_zh: 众议院小组的共和党人批评美国政府对众议院监督委员会共和党人杰弗里·爱泼斯坦和吉斯莱恩·麦克斯韦尔的调查
body_en: House Republicans urge DoJ to further investigate ‘key witnesses’ in Epstein case | Jeffrey Epstein
Republicans on House panel criticize US government’s investigation into Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell

Republicans on the House oversight committee released a report on Tuesday criticizing the federal government’s handling of the investigations into Jeffrey Epstein and his associate, Ghislaine Maxwell , and called on the Department of Justice to interview “key witnesses, investigate Epstein associates accused of criminal activity, and ensure survivors have access to their records”.

“The federal government has failed the survivors of Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell’s horrific crimes for decades,” James Comer, the Republican congressman who chairs the committee, said in a statement .
Comer also urged Congress to pass legislation he introduced that he said would “ensure witnesses and survivors and sexual crimes are not deterred from speaking freely by nondisclosure agreements”.

“We cannot undo the horrific harm inflicted on these women” he said. “But we must ensure that allegations of criminal activity are thoroughly investigated, survivors are protected, and those responsible are held accountable. The failures of the past must not be repeated.”
In a statement, a justice department spokesperson said: “The chairman’s recommendations have already been addressed.
“The attorney general has repeatedly said that the Epstein case is not closed and there is no statute of limitations on human trafficking.”
Shortly after Comer released the report, Robert Garcia, the top Democrat on the committee, called the report “misleading” and “partisan”.

“Oversight Republicans have released a report based on an incomplete investigation and zero public hearings on Jeffrey Epstein” Garcia said. In his statement, he accused the justice department of continuing to “illegally withhold over 2.5m pages of documents” and said that there has been “no investigation of Ghislaine Maxwell’s transfer, and Attorney General Todd Blanche has yet to testify”.

The majority’s report outlines some of the findings that the oversight committee has come to during their 15-month long investigation into Epstein, including how Epstein cultivated and leveraged relationships with powerful people, and the failures of federal investigators and prosecutors, perhaps most notably the brokering of the controversial non-prosecution agreement and plea deal for Epstein in 2008, which led to his federal case at the time being shelved.
The panel’s investigation has included 19 transcribed interviews and seven depositions.

The report also claims that after the enactment of the Epstein Files Transparency Act last year, the justice department “failed to adequately communicate about document releases and failed to sufficiently protect survivors”.

It adds that “questions remain as to whether the DoJ has released all relevant documents”. Moreover, it states “given the speed with which EFTA records were released, several instances of deficient redaction exposed sensitive information of survivors”.

Among the recommendations, Comer is urging the justice department to further question and investigate Epstein’s longtime assistant, Lesley Groff , who testified before the panel earlier this year. Groff told lawmakers that she had no knowledge of Epstein’s crimes while working for him.

Comer also urged the justice department to investigate sexual assault allegations involving two men made by another one of Epstein’s former assistants, Sarah Kellen. Both men have denied any wrongdoing.

The Republican congressman also said the justice department should establish an “appropriate process for Epstein survivors and their representatives to access their personal files and records in unredacted form”, and more.

In a matter of weeks, Democrats will take over the committee in the 120th Congress. Garcia said: “We intend to hold real public hearings uplifting survivors and asking tough questions of the powerful men who associated with Epstein, including Donald Trump. Our work is just getting started.”
body_zh: 众议院共和党人敦促司法部进一步调查爱泼斯坦案的“关键证人”杰弗里·爱泼斯坦
众议院小组中的共和党人批评美国政府对杰弗里·爱泼斯坦和吉斯兰·麦克斯韦尔的调查
众议院监督委员会的共和党人周二发布了一份报告，批评联邦政府对杰弗里·爱泼斯坦及其同事吉斯莱恩·麦克斯韦尔调查的处理方式，并呼吁司法部采访“关键证人，调查被指控从事犯罪活动的爱泼斯坦同事，并确保幸存者能够查阅他们的记录”。
“几十年来，联邦政府辜负了杰弗里·爱泼斯坦和吉斯莱恩·麦克斯韦可怕罪行的幸存者，”委员会主席、共和党国会议员詹姆斯·科默在一份声明中表示。
科默还敦促国会通过他提出的立法，他说这将“确保证人和幸存者以及性犯罪不会因保密协议而无法自由发言”。
他说：“我们无法挽回对这些妇女造成的可怕伤害。” “但我们必须确保对犯罪活动的指控进行彻底调查，保护幸存者，追究责任人的责任。过去的失败绝不能重演。”
司法部发言人在一份声明中表示：“主席的建议已经得到解决。
“总检察长一再表示，爱泼斯坦案尚未结案，人口贩运也没有时效。”
科默发布报告后不久，该委员会民主党领袖罗伯特·加西亚称该报告“具有误导性”和“党派偏见”。
加西亚说：“监督共和党人基于对杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的不完整调查和零公开听证会发布了一份报告。”他在声明中指责司法部继续“非法扣留超过 250 万页文件”，并表示“尚未对吉斯莱恩·麦克斯韦的调动进行调查，司法部长托德·布兰奇也尚未出庭作证”。
多数派的报告概述了监督委员会在对爱泼斯坦长达15个月的调查中得出的一些调查结果，包括爱泼斯坦如何培养和利用与有权势人士的关系，以及联邦调查人员和检察官的失败，也许最引人注目的是2008年为爱泼斯坦达成有争议的不起诉协议和认罪协议，这导致他当时的联邦案件被搁置。
该小组的调查包括 19 份采访记录和 7 份证词。
报告还声称，去年《爱泼斯坦档案透明度法案》颁布后，司法部“未能就文件发布进行充分沟通，也未能充分保护幸存者”。
它补充说，“司法部是否已发布所有相关文件仍存在疑问”。此外，它还指出“鉴于欧洲自由贸易联盟记录的发布速度，数起编辑不足的情况暴露了幸存者的敏感信息”。
在这些建议中，科默敦促司法部进一步询问和调查爱泼斯坦的长期助手莱斯利·格罗夫(Lesley Groff)，她今年早些时候在专家组上作证。格罗夫告诉立法者，她在为爱泼斯坦工作期间并不了解他的罪行。
科默还敦促司法部调查爱泼斯坦的另一位前助手莎拉·凯伦对两名男子提出的性侵犯指控。两人均否认有任何不当行为。
这位共和党国会议员还表示，司法部应该建立“适当的程序，让爱泼斯坦幸存者及其代表以未经编辑的形式访问他们的个人档案和记录”等等。
几周后，民主党将在第 120 届国会接管该委员会。加西亚说：“我们打算举行真正的公开听证会，鼓舞幸存者，并向包括唐纳德·特朗普在内的与爱泼斯坦有联系的有权势人士提出尖锐的问题。我们的工作才刚刚开始。”

title_en: Impeachment isn't only for presidents. How does the process work for Cabinet secretaries?
title_zh: 弹劾不仅针对总统。内阁秘书的流程如何？
summary: The Constitution allows Congress to impeach and remove federal officials, including Cabinet secretaries
summary_zh: 宪法允许国会弹劾和罢免联邦官员，包括内阁部长
body_en: The Constitution allows Congress to impeach and remove federal officials, including Cabinet secretaries
The process of impeachment often arises in discussions around congressional action against a sitting president. But how does it work for other U.S. government officials?
The same provision that allows Congress to impeach a president — Article II, Section 4 — also gives it the authority to impeach and remove federal officials, including Cabinet secretaries

“The President, Vice President and all civil Officers of the United States, shall be removed from Office on Impeachment for, and Conviction of, Treason, Bribery, or other high Crimes and Misdemeanors.”
Cabinet secretaries are included in the part about “all civil Officers of the United States.”

There's no strict definition of “high crimes and misdemeanors,” and it isn't necessarily akin to violation of a criminal statute or court conviction. Historically, for presidents and other officials, impeachment has been used to address abuses of official power and breaches of public trust.

Cases originate in the House of Representatives, with the introduction of a resolution or a committee investigating allegations. The House investigates alleged misconduct and decides whether to formally charge an official through articles of impeachment.
If that happens, and a simple majority of the House votes to impeach, then the Senate holds a trial.
For presidents, how that trial is conducted is explicitly set out in the Constitution, with the chief justice of the U.S. Supreme Court presiding.
It's not as clear for Cabinet secretaries as to who oversees the proceedings.

Teacher's aide arrested in connection with NYC jogger's murder: Police

Just like for presidents, saying that someone has been impeached is basically a formal accusation, not a conviction. A secretary who has been impeached by the House can continue serving while the Senate considers the charges.
It takes a simple majority in the House to technically impeach a Cabinet secretary. But for a conviction in the Senate, it takes a two-thirds vote, a significantly higher threshold.

William W. Belknap, who served as war secretary for President Ulysses S. Grant, was the first Cabinet secretary to be impeached. He resigned hours before the House voted to impeach him in 1876 on allegations he accepted bribes in a trading post scandal.

The second Cabinet secretary to be impeached was Alejandro Mayorkas, who served as Homeland Security Secretary in the Biden administration. The House narrowly voted to impeach Mayorkas in February 2024. The Senate dismissed the case two months later, saying it didn't meet constitutional standards, and Mayorkas continued to serve until President Joe Biden left office.

body_zh: 宪法允许国会弹劾和罢免联邦官员，包括内阁部长
弹劾过程经常出现在围绕国会针对现任总统采取行动的讨论中。但它对其他美国政府官员来说如何运作呢？
允许国会弹劾总统的同一条款——第二条第四节——也赋予国会弹劾和罢免联邦官员的权力，包括内阁部长
“美国总统、副总统和所有文职官员因叛国罪、贿赂或其他重罪和轻罪而被弹劾和定罪，应被免职。”
“美国所有文职官员”部分包含内阁秘书。
“重罪和轻罪”没有严格的定义，也不一定类似于违反刑事法规或法院定罪。从历史上看，对于总统和其他官员来说，弹劾曾被用来解决滥用官方权力和违反公众信任的问题。
案件由众议院发起，提出决议或成立委员会调查指控。众议院调查涉嫌不当行为，并决定是否通过弹劾条款正式指控一名官员。
如果发生这种情况，并且众议院以简单多数投票支持弹劾，那么参议院将进行审判。
对于总统来说，审判的进行方式在宪法中有明确规定，并由美国最高法院首席大法官主持。
对于内阁秘书来说，尚不清楚谁来监督整个过程。
父亲因涉嫌让6岁女儿排队领取神奇宝贝卡而被捕
警方助理因涉嫌谋杀纽约市慢跑者而被捕
就像总统一样，说某人被弹劾基本上是正式指控，而不是定罪。被众议院弹劾的秘书可以在参议院审议指控期间继续任职。
从技术上讲，弹劾内阁秘书需要众议院的简单多数票。但要在参议院定罪，需要三分之二的票数，这个门槛要高得多。
担任尤利西斯·S·格兰特总统的战争部长的威廉·贝尔纳普是第一位被弹劾的内阁部长。 1876 年，众议院因指控他在贸易站丑闻中收受贿赂而投票弹劾他，数小时前他就辞职了。
第二位被弹劾的内阁部长是拜登政府中担任国土安全部部长的亚历杭德罗·马约卡斯(Alejandro Mayorkas)。 2024 年 2 月，众议院以微弱优势投票弹劾马约卡斯。两个月后，参议院驳回了此案，称其不符合宪法标准，马约卡斯继续任职，直到乔·拜登总统离任。

title_en: Court filing alleges Trump adviser received cash, luxury gifts from foreign interests
title_zh: 法庭文件称特朗普顾问收受外国利益集团的现金和豪华礼物
summary: The filing from Alex Bruesewitz’s ex-business partner Derek Utley is a response to an earlier lawsuit claiming Utley embezzled millions from their firm, X Strategies.
summary_zh: 亚历克斯·布鲁塞维茨 (Alex Bruesewitz) 的前商业伙伴德里克·厄特利 (Derek Utley) 提交的文件是对此前一项诉讼的回应，该诉讼声称厄特利从他们的第一家公司挪用了数百万美元。
body_en: A former business partner is accusing MAGA media guru Alex Bruesewitz of receiving lavish gifts from foreign individuals in Qatar and Syria while also pursuing lucrative deals with other entities looking to unlock access to U.S. government officials.

The allegations were made in a court filing Monday by Derek Utley, who co-founded the digital firm X Strategies in 2017 with Bruesewitz. Bruesewitz is a top outside adviser to President Donald Trump , having helped shape his 2024 campaign’s digital strategy, and X Strategies maintains the Trump War Room and Team Trump accounts on X.
The company sued Utley in September , alleging he embezzled and gambled away millions of dollars from the firm.

In the Monday filing responding to that lawsuit, Utley calls it a “marketing ploy masquerading as a federal lawsuit” and denies allegations he embezzled the company’s money or used its funds to gamble. The filing includes a countersuit against X Strategies that claims Utley was fired from the company without cause over a requested medical leave. (The firm’s original lawsuit had claimed Utley submitted “fake medical records” to "fraudulently" get six months paid leave, and was then fired.)

Utley doesn’t explicitly accuse Bruesewitz of offering foreign officials political access in exchange for payments, but charges that Bruesewitz “pursued substantial business and financial relationships with foreign individuals, investors, and governmental representatives, including persons associated with Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, and Syria” while concealing those relationships. The filing does not include documentation to support its allegations.

“The relationships and access Bruesewitz cultivated through X Strategies were valuable commercial assets, particularly to foreign interests seeking introductions to American political figures, access to governmental institutions, or assistance advancing their commercial and political objectives,” the filing says. “Upon information and belief, Bruesewitz received approximately $500,000 from individuals associated with Qatar in connection with an undisclosed business or consulting arrangement.”
Bruesewitz’s lawyer Bradford Cohen denied all the allegations.
“These are things that would be defamatory if made outside the four corners of the complaint,” Cohen said Monday evening, vowing to "vigorously" defend against the allegations.

“We're asserting that everything in his factual allegations is either untrue, exaggerated, or completely fabricated,” he said. “Desperate men resort to desperate things, and this screams of desperation.”

Bruesewitz continues to advise conservative figures in Trump’s orbit. He also leveraged his relationships with foreign officials when the war with Iran broke out to help charter a flight back to the U.S. for himself and other Americans who were stranded in Qatar, according to his social media posts at the time.
Utley did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Neither did the White House.

In another example, Utley claims Bruesewitz sought to charge an annual advisory fee of $1 million to a “Copenhagen-based investment firm with holdings in the United States and Europe.” The proposed deal, the filing said, included services like “providing access to American governmental officials, federal agencies, and financial institutions.”

“These circumstances raise questions concerning potential registration and disclosure obligations under FARA,” the court filing says, referencing the Foreign Agents Registration Act, which requires public disclosures from those involved in lobbying or other activities representing foreign interests.

Additionally, the filing alleges that Bruesewitz told Utley that his honeymoon hotel stay in the Maldives was paid for by “two Syrian billionaires” who provided access to a suite that ordinarily costs $15,000 a night.

Bruesewitz has previously advocated for conservative influencers to disclose their relationships with foreign governments seeking to sway the Trump administration. He also said during a June interview with Tucker Carlson that he does not take any foreign payments.

“Getting foreign influence out of the political ecosystem, specifically online, is a very — it’s a passion project of mine,” Bruesewitz said in the interview. “You can only imagine the type of money that these countries and other companies have tried to throw at me. I do not take any foreign money. I don’t take any money from the Gulf countries. I don't take any money from India. I don't take any money from Russia, China. No foreign countries.”
body_zh: 一位前商业伙伴指责 MAGA 媒体大师亚历克斯·布鲁塞维茨 (Alex Bruesewitz) 接受卡塔尔和叙利亚的外国人士的奢华礼物，同时还与其他实体寻求利润丰厚的交易，以期接触到美国政府官员。
这些指控是德里克·乌特利 (Derek Utley) 周一在一份法庭文件中提出的，他于 2017 年与 Bruesewitz 共同创立了数字公司 X Strategies。 Bruesewitz 是唐纳德·特朗普总统的高级外部顾问，帮助制定了他的 2024 年竞选数字战略，X Strategies 维护着 X 上的特朗普作战室和特朗普团队账户。
该公司于 9 月起诉尤特利，指控他贪污并赌博从公司骗走了数百万美元。
在周一回应该诉讼的文件中，乌特利称其为“伪装成联邦诉讼的营销策略”，并否认他挪用公司资金或利用公司资金赌博的指控。该文件包括针对 X Strategies 的反诉讼，声称 Utley 因请求病假而被公司无故解雇。 （该公司最初的诉讼声称，厄特利提交了“虚假医疗记录”，以“欺骗性地”获得六个月的带薪休假，然后被解雇。）
乌特利没有明确指责布鲁塞维茨向外国官员提供政治准入以换取报酬，但指控布鲁塞维茨“与外国个人、投资者和政府代表，包括与卡塔尔、阿拉伯联合酋长国和叙利亚有关的人员”建立实质性的商业和金融关系，同时隐瞒了这些关系。该文件不包括支持其指控的文件。
文件称：“Bruesewitz 通过 X Strategies 建立的关系和接触机会是宝贵的商业资产，特别是对于寻求结识美国政治人物、接触政府机构或协助推进其商业和政治目标的外国利益集团而言。” “据了解并确信，Bruesewitz 从与卡塔尔有关的个人那里收到了大约 50 万美元，涉及一项未公开的业务或咨询安排。”
布鲁塞维茨的律师布拉德福德·科恩否认了所有指控。
科恩周一晚间表示，“如果在投诉的四个角落之外提出这些内容，那将是诽谤性的”，并发誓要“大力”对这些指控进行辩护。
“我们断言，他的事实指控中的一切要么是不真实的、夸大的，要么完全是捏造的，”他说。 “绝望的人诉诸绝望的事情，这就是绝望的尖叫。”
布鲁塞维茨继续为特朗普身边的保守派人物提供建议。根据他当时的社交媒体帖子，在与伊朗的战争爆发时，他还利用与外国官员的关系，帮助自己和其他滞留在卡塔尔的美国人包机返回美国。
乌特利没有立即回应置评请求。白宫也没有。
在另一个例子中，Utley 声称 Bruesewitz 试图向一家“总部位于哥本哈根、在美国和欧洲持有股份的投资公司”收取 100 万美元的年度咨询费。文件称，拟议的交易包括“提供与美国政府官员、联邦机构和金融机构接触的机会”等服务。
法院文件称，“这些情况引发了有关《外国代理人登记法》规定的潜在登记和披露义务的问题。”该文件援引了《外国代理人登记法》，该法要求参与游说或代表外国利益的其他活动的人员进行公开披露。
此外，文件称布鲁塞维茨告诉尤特利，他在马尔代夫的蜜月酒店住宿费用是由“两名叙利亚亿万富翁”支付的，他们提供了一套通常每晚 15,000 美元的套房。
布鲁塞维茨此前曾主张保守派影响者披露他们与外国政府的关系，以期影响特朗普政府。他还在六月接受塔克·卡尔森采访时表示，他不接受任何外国付款。
“让外国影响力脱离政治生态系统，特别是在网上，是我的一个非常热情的项目，”布鲁塞维茨在采访中说。 “你只能想象这些国家和其他公司试图向我扔什么样的钱。我不接受任何外国资金。我不接受来自海湾国家的任何资金。我不接受来自印度的任何资金。我不接受来自俄罗斯、中国的任何资金。没有外国的。”

title_en: Democrats demand answers on 8-year-old Haitian boy detained by ICE
title_zh: 民主党人要求对被 ICE 拘留的 8 岁海地男孩作出答复
summary: ‘Video footage appears to show the use of restraints on a child who seemed to pose no threat to those around him’ Democratic lawmakers in California are demanding answers from the Trump administration about the safety and whereabouts of an eight-year-old Haiti
summary_zh: 加州民主党议员表示，“视频片段似乎显示，对一名似乎对周围人没有构成威胁的孩子使用了束缚”。
body_en: ‘Video footage appears to show the use of restraints on a child who seemed to pose no threat to those around him’

Democratic lawmakers in California are demanding answers from the Trump administration about the safety and whereabouts of an eight-year-old Haitian boy who they say was put in restraints and taken into custody by federal immigration officers at a check-in last week.

Video obtained by NBC News shows the third-grader being led away by three armed officials after he was summoned to what his family said was a routine immigration appointment in San Diego on 4 November.

On Tuesday, California’s US senators Alex Padilla and Adam Schiff joined four Democratic Congress members in sending an oversight letter to homeland security secretary Markwayne Mullin and health secretary Robert F Kennedy Jr , asking for an explanation.

“Video footage appears to show the use of restraints on a child who seemed to pose no threat to those around him, raising serious questions about the handling of this incident,” the lawmakers wrote. “We express concerns about the basis for this action and the harm it may cause a young child who appeared for his required hearing.”

A spokesperson for congressman Juan Vargas, one of the signatories, told the Guardian that he had “repeatedly” contacted the departments of homeland security, and health and human services, but heard nothing back.

The letter, the spokesperson said, seeks “confirmation on the child’s whereabouts, answers on whether or not the child’s family is aware of his location, and what steps the agencies are taking to ensure he can be reunited with them”.

The Haitian Bridge Alliance, an immigration advocacy group, said the boy, who attends the city’s Fay elementary school, was in the care of his uncle and cousins after his father was deported last year.

Guerline Jozef, the group’s executive director, told NBC’s San Diego news affiliate KNSD that she learned he was taken into custody after the uncle took him to the appointment, then later transferred to the office of refugee resettlement (ORR), a government agency under the direction of the health and human services department.
A spokesperson for the homeland security department said Immigration and Customs Enforcement ( ICE ) took the child into custody “out of an abundance of caution and to ensure the child’s safety”.

The uncle, the spokesperson said in a statement to the Guardian, was unable to prove legal guardianship – and that officials were obliged by federal anti-trafficking laws to take the boy into care as an “unaccompanied alien child”.

“Allegations that ICE took a third grader into custody to be placed in detention are false, and any suggestion otherwise is a depraved attempt to smear our ICE law enforcement officers and undermine the work of President Trump and Secretary Mullin to protect children,” the statement said.

It added that the boy lacked legal immigration status and was brought to the US by his father, who was then deported to Mexico by Customs and Border Protection (CBP), another federal immigration enforcement agency.
Jozef told NBC that the father’s abrupt deportation meant there was no opportunity to transfer formal legal guardianship to relatives of the boy in the US.

“His father has already been taken from him and deported, now this administration has stripped him of the stability, family, and community every child deserves,” she said. “I’m sure he is fearful, he is traumatized.”

Community leaders, including the board and superintendent of the San Diego unified school district (SDUSD), wrote to ICE expressing concern about the Trump administration’s decision to revoke temporary protected status (TPS) safeguards for Haitians in the US and its impact on families.
“ICE understands that this is absolutely not where this child should be,” Cody Petterson, a trustee of SDUSD, told NBC.

“For us, it’s a very clear case in which there’s no question that the best place for this child is with their caregiver, their uncle, and one of the worst places they could possibly be is in a cage somewhere with nobody they know, not understanding the process, and not understanding what’s about to happen to them.”
Jozef said the Haitian community was living “under a cloud of terror”, and that the loss of TPS protections was “incredibly painful” for families who had built lives in the US.
body_zh: “视频片段似乎显示对一个似乎对周围的人没有构成威胁的孩子使用了束缚”
加利福尼亚州的民主党议员要求特朗普政府就一名八岁海地男孩的安全和下落做出答复，他们称这名男孩在上周的一次登记时被联邦移民官员限制并拘留。
NBC新闻获得的视频显示，11月4日，这名三年级学生被传唤去圣地亚哥进行例行移民预约，据其家人称，他被三名武装官员带走。
周二，加州参议员亚历克斯·帕迪拉和亚当·希夫与四名民主党国会议员一起向国土安全部长马克韦恩·穆林和卫生部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪发出了一封监督信，要求做出解释。
立法者写道：“视频片段似乎显示对一名似乎对周围的人没有构成威胁的儿童使用了束缚，这对这一事件的处理提出了严重质疑。” “我们对这一行动的依据以及它可能对出席听证会的幼儿造成的伤害表示担忧。”
签署人之一、国会议员胡安·巴尔加斯的发言人告诉《卫报》，他“多次”联系国土安全部、卫生与公众服务部，但没有收到任何回复。
发言人表示，这封信寻求“确认孩子的下落，回答孩子的家人是否知道他的位置，以及各机构正在采取哪些措施来确保他能够与他们团聚”。
移民倡导组织海地桥梁联盟表示，这名男孩就读于该市费伊小学，去年父亲被驱逐出境后，由他的叔叔和表兄弟照顾。
该组织的执行董事 Guerline Jozef 告诉 NBC 圣地亚哥新闻附属机构 KNSD，她在叔叔带他去赴约后得知他被拘留，随后被转移到难民安置办公室 (ORR)，这是一个隶属于卫生与公众服务部的政府机构。
美国国土安全部发言人表示，移民和海关执法局（ICE）“出于高度谨慎并确保孩子的安全”而拘留了这名孩子。
发言人在给《卫报》的一份声明中表示，这名叔叔无法证明其合法监护权，并且根据联邦反人口贩卖法，官员们有义务将这名男孩作为“无人陪伴的外国儿童”予以照顾。
声明称：“有关 ICE 拘留一名三年级学生的指控是错误的，任何其他说法都是诽谤我们 ICE 执法人员并破坏特朗普总统和穆林国务卿保护儿童工作的邪恶企图。”
声明补充说，这名男孩没有合法移民身份，是由他的父亲带到美国的，然后他的父亲被另一个联邦移民执法机构海关和边境保护局（CBP）驱逐到墨西哥。
约瑟夫告诉全国广播公司，父亲的突然被驱逐意味着没有机会将正式的法定监护权转移给男孩在美国的亲属。
“他的父亲已经被带走并被驱逐出境，现在这届政府剥夺了他每个孩子应有的稳定、家庭和社区，”她说。 “我确信他很害怕，他受到了创伤。”
包括圣地亚哥联合学区 (SDUSD) 的董事会和学监在内的社区领袖写信给 ICE，表达了对特朗普政府决定撤销美国海地人临时保护身份 (TPS) 保障措施及其对家庭影响的担忧。
SDUSD 受托人科迪·佩特森 (Cody Petterson) 告诉 NBC，“ICE 知道这绝对不是这个孩子应该呆的地方。”
“对我们来说，这是一个非常明显的案例，毫无疑问，这个孩子最好的地方是和他们的照顾者、他们的叔叔在一起，而他们可能呆在笼子里，没有人认识，不了解这个过程，也不了解他们将要发生什么。”
约瑟夫表示，海地社区生活在“恐怖的阴云之下”，失去 TPS 保护对于在美国生活的家庭来说是“极其痛苦的”。

title_en: Democrats plot their course on national popular vote
title_zh: 民主党人根据全国普选制定路线
summary: Democrats have won unified control of enough swing states — Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, and Michigan — to sidestep the Electoral College. Will they back the effort?
summary_zh: 民主党已经赢得了足够多摇摆州（宾夕法尼亚州、威斯康星州和密歇根州）的统一控制权，以避开选举团制度。他们会回来吗
body_en: Democrats who just triumphed in a number of battlegrounds are facing pressure to make their states just a little less powerful in the fight for the presidency.

The party’s sweeping victories present an opportunity for Democrats in states with newly won trifectas to join the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact, an agreement between states to make sure whoever wins national popular vote becomes president by awarding their Electoral College votes to that winner, rather than the winner of the most votes in their state.

The compact would go into effect when it’s enacted in states whose combined electoral vote total is at least 270. Currently, 18 historically blue states and Washington D.C. have joined the compact, a two-decade-long, nonpartisan project, with a combined 222 electoral votes.

That means if Pennsylvania, Michigan and Wisconsin join, along with either Arizona or Nevada, the compact would go into effect in every member state, making it possible for the next president to be elected by winning the popular vote while losing the Electoral College. All five states will now be under unified Democratic control starting next year.
Democrats in those five states, which will likely be battlegrounds in 2028 under the current system, have supported switching to national popular vote in the past.

But it’s unclear whether they will move forward on national popular vote after gaining historic trifectas on the back of promising to lower costs for voters — a move that would make their own states less crucial for the 2028 presidential battle.

Incoming Arizona Senate Majority Leader Priya Sundareshan told POLITICO her caucus will take up the national popular vote, but the timing remains unsettled. Sundareshan added she hasn’t spoken to Arizona Gov. Katie Hobbs about national popular vote. Hobbs’ office declined to comment.

“We certainly are and have been prepared to join the compact, and we also want to make sure that we are showing that our priorities are reflective of what we really focused on on the campaign trail,” she said.

Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro told POLITICO he is “open” to signing his state into the compact but suggested he hasn’t yet coordinated with state legislators on how national popular vote fits in with the rest of his agenda. He said separately Saturday at Crooked Media’s “Crooked Con” that the national popular vote “makes sense” and pledged to work with lawmakers “to figure out what the right mechanism going forward on that.”

Some state leaders say they know they’d draw challenges and political fury if they attempt to rewrite the nation’s rules for electing presidents. Incoming Michigan Senate Majority Leader Darrin Camilleri said he’s open to enacting a national popular vote, but conceded that any change would likely invite lawsuits from Republicans.

“Other states that have done this are not going to be the tipping-point states. We very well could be one of those tipping point-states, and so I want to ensure that everybody is on the same page,” Camilleri said.
Michigan Gov.-elect Jocelyn Benson’s representatives did not respond to a request for comment.

Wisconsin Gov.-elect David Crowley previously backed a 2019 bill to have Wisconsin join the compact. When asked if he would do so as governor, Crowley said in a statement he “is focused on assembling an experienced transition team so his administration can be ready on day one to deliver results for working families across the Badger State.”

Ben Wikler, the former Wisconsin Democratic Party chair and national popular vote advocate, dismissed concerns about battleground states diminishing their prominence in presidential elections, even as he acknowledged that “battleground states passing the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact is like the popular kids abolishing the concept of popularity.”

“I've spoken to audiences all over the state of Wisconsin,” Wikler said. “Everyone here agrees that Wisconsinites shouldn't be high and mighty, lording over the powerless voters in the coastal states. We should be a one-person, one-vote democracy.”

When Nevada Democrats held a trifecta in 2019, they put a bill to join the compact on former Gov. Steve Sisolak’s desk, but Sisolak vetoed it out of concern it would diminish the role of smaller states like Nevada in the electoral process. Nevada Gov.-elect Aaron Ford’s office declined to comment.
Despite the uncertainty, the outside groups pushing the compact are optimistic enough states will join to trigger the compact ahead of the 2028 election.
“I’ve never been more confident in my life,” said Patrick Rosenstiel, a spokesperson for National Popular Vote, the bipartisan group behind the compact.
body_zh: 刚刚在多个战场上取得胜利的民主党人正面临着压力，要求他们削弱自己所在州在总统竞选中的实力。
该党的压倒性胜利为新赢得三连胜的各州的民主党人提供了加入《全国普选州际契约》的机会，该协议是各州之间的一项协议，旨在确保赢得全国普选的人通过将选举人团选票授予获胜者而不是本州最多选票的获胜者来成为总统。
该契约将在选举人票总数至少为 270 票的州颁布后生效。目前，已有 18 个历史上的蓝色州和华盛顿特区加入了该契约，这是一个长达 20 年的无党派项目，共有 222 张选举人票。
这意味着，如果宾夕法尼亚州、密歇根州和威斯康星州以及亚利桑那州或内华达州加入，该协议将在每个成员国生效，从而使下一任总统有可能通过赢得普选而失去选举人团而当选。从明年开始，所有五个州都将处于民主党的统一控制之下。
这五个州的民主党人过去曾支持转向全国普选，而在现行制度下，这五个州可能会成为 2028 年的战场。
但目前尚不清楚他们在承诺降低选民成本后获得历史性三连胜后是否会在全国普选中取得进展——此举将使他们自己的州在 2028 年总统之战中变得不那么重要。
即将上任的亚利桑那州参议院多数党领袖 Priya Sundareshan 告诉《政治》杂志，她的核心小组将进行全国普选，但时间安排仍未确定。 Sundareshan 补充说，她还没有与亚利桑那州州长凯蒂·霍布斯讨论全国普选的问题。霍布斯办公室拒绝发表评论。
她说：“我们当然已经准备好加入该契约，我们还希望确保我们的优先事项反映了我们在竞选活动中真正关注的重点。”
宾夕法尼亚州州长乔什·夏皮罗告诉《政治》杂志，他对在该州签署该协议“持开放态度”，但表示他尚未与州立法者就全国普选如何配合他的其余议程进行协调。周六，他在 Crooked Media 的“Crooked Con”上单独表示，全国普选“有意义”，并承诺与立法者合作“找出正确的机制”。
一些国家领导人表示，他们知道，如果他们试图改写国家选举总统的规则，就会招致挑战和政治愤怒。即将上任的密歇根州参议院多数党领袖达林·卡米莱里(Darrin Camilleri)表示，他对实施全国普选持开放态度，但承认任何改变都可能招致共和党人的诉讼。
“其他已经这样做的州不会成为临界点国家。我们很可能成为那些临界点国家之一，所以我想确保每个人都达成共识，”卡米莱里说。
密歇根州当选州长乔斯林·本森的代表没有回应置评请求。
威斯康星州当选州长戴维·克劳利 (David Crowley) 此前支持威斯康星州加入该契约的 2019 年法案。当被问及他作为州长是否会这样做时，克劳利在一份声明中表示，他“专注于组建一支经验丰富的过渡团队，以便他的政府能够在第一天就做好准备，为整个獾州的工薪家庭提供成果。”
威斯康星州民主党前主席、全国普选倡导者本·威克勒（Ben Wikler）驳斥了人们对战场州在总统选举中影响力下降的担忧，尽管他承认“战场州通过《全国普选州际契约》就像受欢迎的孩子废除了受欢迎程度的概念。”
“我已经对威斯康星州各地的观众进行了演讲，”威克勒说。 “这里的每个人都同意，威斯康星人不应该高高在上，对沿海各州无权的选民发号施令。我们应该成为一个人一票的民主国家。”
2019 年内华达州民主党举行三连胜时，他们将一项加入该契约的法案提交到前州长史蒂夫·西索拉克 (Steve Sisolak) 的办公桌上，但西索拉克否决了该法案，因为他担心这会削弱内华达州等较小州在选举过程中的作用。内华达州当选州长亚伦·福特的办公室拒绝发表评论。
尽管存在不确定性，推动该契约的外部团体对各州将在 2028 年大选前加入并触发该契约持乐观态度。
“我对自己的生活从未如此自信，”该契约背后的两党组织全国民众投票组织的发言人帕特里克·罗森斯蒂尔说。

title_en: Why did California's billionaire tax fail to surf the blue wave?
title_zh: 为何加州的亿万富翁税未能乘风破浪？
summary: Two economists debate what California's vote on Prop 40 means for the wealth tax movement.
summary_zh: 两位经济学家争论加州对 40 号提案的投票对财富税运动意味着什么。

Ultrasound Technologist Mayra Castaneda speaks in front of healthcare workers holding placards in support of the Billionaire Tax during a media briefing in Los Angeles on April 27, 2026. Healthcare workers and allies outlined the next steps in their effort to get California's Billionaire Tax on the ballot for the November election, with their efforts already exceeding 1,500,000 signatures collected from across the state. The initiative would levy a one-time 5% tax on California billionaires. (Photo by Frederic J. BROWN / AFP via Getty Images) FREDERIC J. BROWN/AFP via Getty Images/AFP hide caption

Late Monday, The Associated Press determined that California voters had rejected Prop 40, the proposed billionaire wealth tax I wrote about last week . Given the big blue wave we saw during the midterms, why did this tax on billionaires fail to surf to victory?

To make sense of the results, I went back to the two economists I spoke with last week: UC Berkeley's Gabriel Zucman, a leading champion of wealth taxes, and Stanford's Joshua Rauh, a prominent critic of Prop 40.

Last week, they disagreed on what this wealth tax on billionaires would do to California's economy and tax revenue. Now comes the sequel, in which they disagree on what the results say about the politics of wealth taxes.
Their debate could foreshadow a bigger one in the next Democratic presidential primary: should the party embrace a wealth tax?
Zucman blames the corrosive influence of money for Prop 40's failure.

"I am not surprised," Zucman says. Opponents of Prop 40 spent almost $400 million fighting it, including spending on competing ballot measures, making it one of the most expensive ballot initiative fights in history.

"The money spent by the billionaires was critical," Zucman says. "Anyone who lives in California has been carpet-bombed by a deluge of ads. One can easily see how this could be pivotal in such a closely contested ballot."

But didn't Democrats win plenty of races this cycle despite huge sums spent against them? In Texas, for example, Elon Musk alone poured more than $150 million into defeating Democrat James Talarico. And Talarico ended up winning his Senate race by a comfortable margin . Why would money have been so decisive with Prop 40 and not in other races around the nation?

For one, Zucman says, the spending gap was much bigger in the fight over Prop 40. "The billionaires spent more than $300 million on ads versus negligible sums on the other side," Zucman says. "On TV and in their mailboxes, voters were exposed only to the anti-tax arguments. This was very different from the other midterm races: in those races, when spending was high (e.g., Talarico vs. Paxton in Texas) it was high on both sides, even if unevenly. The net difference in spending was considerably larger for Prop 40."

It's also possible that money can matter more in ballot initiatives than in races between candidates. Analysts have complained for decades that California's ballot initiative system is too easily manipulated by special interest groups. The nitty-gritty details of specific policies can get complicated, and many voters don't take the time to get educated on them. That can give well-funded advertising campaigns more power to shape their views.

In candidate races, meanwhile, voters can at least fall back on name recognition or party labels, which give them an easy mental shortcut — what social scientists call a "heuristic" — when making decisions at the ballot box. Even when they know little about the candidates, they usually know which party they prefer.

But Prop 40 didn't come with the same clear partisan signal. In fact, prominent Democrats, including California Gov. Gavin Newsom, came out against it. Newsom said he favored a national minimum tax on billionaires instead.
"Popular opinion on wealth taxes is clearly not as strong as proponents thought," Rauh says.

Rauh questions whether money and advertising can really explain Prop 40's poor showing. He compared support for the tax with support for Kamala Harris in the 2024 presidential election. In some of "the most progressive Bay Area counties," he says, Harris won overwhelming support while Prop 40 won much less. This gap between support for Harris and support for Prop 40 was bigger there than it was in other Democratic-leaning counties across the state.

If advertising was the main explanation for this tax's poor showing, he argues, why was the gap so much bigger in the Bay Area? Sure, he says, advertisers may have done more targeting there, but he thinks the uneven pattern across the state casts doubt on the idea that advertising was the decisive factor.

"[T]he counties with the largest defections are actually the ones whose residents are most likely to know a billionaire, to work for one, or to have watched one move to Texas or Florida," Rauh writes in a recent post . "The simple reading is that proximity to the people being taxed, and to the businesses they fund, made voters more skeptical of the tax relative to their baseline politics."
For Rauh, that skepticism points to a broader conclusion: "The electorate even in progressive California has shown that it isn't ready for a wealth tax," he says.
body_zh: 您的支持有助于我们的演出成为可能，并解锁我们的无赞助商动态。

2026 年 4 月 27 日，在洛杉矶举行的媒体吹风会上，超声技术专家 Mayra Castaneda 在举着支持亿万富翁税标语牌的医护人员面前发表讲话。医护人员和盟友概述了他们为将加州亿万富翁税纳入 11 月大选选票而做出的下一步努力，他们的努力已经从全州收集了超过 1,500,000 个签名。该倡议将对加州亿万富翁一次性征收 5% 的税。 （弗雷德里克·J·布朗/法新社通过盖蒂图片社拍摄）弗雷德里克·J·布朗/法新社通过盖蒂图片社/法新社 隐藏标题栏
周一晚些时候，美联社确定加州选民拒绝了第 40 号提案，即我上周写过的提议的亿万富翁财富税。鉴于我们在中期选举中看到的巨大蓝色浪潮，为什么对亿万富翁征税未能取得胜利？
为了理解这些结果，我回到了上周采访过的两位经济学家：加州大学伯克利分校的加布里埃尔·祖克曼（Gabriel Zucman），财富税的主要支持者，和斯坦福大学的约书亚·劳（Joshua Rauh），40号提案的著名批评者。
上周，他们在对亿万富翁征收财富税会对加州经济和税收产生什么影响方面存在分歧。现在是续集，他们对结果对财富税政治的看法存在分歧。
他们的辩论可能预示着下届民主党总统初选中一场更大的辩论：该党是否应该接受财富税？
祖克曼将 40 号提案的失败归咎于金钱的腐蚀影响。
“我并不感到惊讶，”祖克曼说。 40 号提案的反对者花费了近 4 亿美元来对抗它，其中包括在竞争性投票措施上的支出，使其成为历史上最昂贵的投票倡议斗争之一。
“亿万富翁们花的钱至关重要，”祖克曼说。 “居住在加利福尼亚州的任何人都受到过大量广告的地毯式轰炸。人们很容易看出这在如此激烈的选票中至关重要。”
但是，尽管民主党在这个周期中花费了大量资金，但他们不是赢得了很多比赛吗？例如，在得克萨斯州，埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）一人就投入了超过 1.5 亿美元来击败民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科（James Talarico）。塔拉里科最终以微弱优势赢得了参议院竞选。为什么金钱在 40 号提案中具有如此决定性的作用，而在全国其他竞选中则不然？
祖克曼表示，首先，在 40 号提案之争中，支出差距要大得多。“亿万富翁在广告上的支出超过 3 亿美元，而另一方的支出则微不足道，”祖克曼说。 “在电视和邮箱中，选民只接触到反税收论点。这与其他中期竞选非常不同：在这些竞选中，当支出很高时（例如德克萨斯州的塔拉里科与帕克斯顿），双方都很高，即使不均衡。40号提案的支出净差异要大得多。”
金钱在投票倡议中也可能比在候选人之间的竞选中更重要。几十年来，分析人士一直抱怨加州的投票倡议制度太容易被特殊利益集团操纵。具体政策的具体细节可能会变得复杂，许多选民不会花时间接受相关教育。这可以让资金充足的广告活动更有能力塑造他们的观点。
与此同时，在候选人竞选中，选民至少可以依靠知名度或政党标签，这为他们在投票箱做出决定时提供了一条简单的心理捷径——社会科学家称之为“启发式”。即使他们对候选人知之甚少，他们通常也知道自己更喜欢哪个政党。
但 40 号提案并没有发出同样明确的党派信号。事实上，包括加州州长加文·纽瑟姆在内的知名民主党人都站出来反对。纽瑟姆表示，他赞成对亿万富翁征收全国最低税。
“对财富税的普遍看法显然并不像支持者想象的那么强烈，”劳说。
Rauh 质疑金钱和广告能否真正解释 40 号提案的糟糕表现。他将对税收的支持与 2024 年总统选举中对卡马拉·哈里斯的支持进行了比较。他说，在一些“湾区最进步的县”，哈里斯赢得了压倒性的支持，而 40 号提案赢得的支持要少得多。那里对哈里斯的支持率和对 40 号提案的支持率之间的差距比全州其他倾向民主党的县更大。
他认为，如果广告是这项税收表现不佳的主要原因，那么为什么湾区的差距如此之大？当然，他说，广告商可能在那里做了更多的定位，但他认为全州的不平衡模式让人对广告是决定性因素的观点产生了怀疑。
“叛逃最多的县实际上是居民最有可能认识亿万富翁、为亿万富翁工作或目睹亿万富翁搬到德克萨斯州或佛罗里达州的县，”劳在最近的一篇文章中写道。 “简单的解读是，与纳税人及其资助的企业的接近，使选民相对于他们的基本政治更加怀疑税收。”
对于劳来说，这种怀疑指向了一个更广泛的结论：“即使是进步的加州选民也表明他们还没有准备好征收财富税，”他说。

title_en: A new set of Democratic power brokers just dropped before 2028
title_zh: 一组新的民主党权力掮客在 2028 年之前刚刚卸任
summary: Presidential hopefuls are already working the phones to build relationships with the new slate of Democratic figures in key early states.
summary_zh: 总统候选人已经在通过电话与关键早期州的新一批民主党人物建立关系。
body_en: The 2028 presidential race is already playing out in the text threads and phone calls of a new set of Democratic power brokers.

A number of would-be White House contenders — including former Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg, Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker, Maryland Gov. Wes Moore, former Ambassador Rahm Emanuel and Sens. Mark Kelly (D-Ariz.) and Cory Booker (D-N.J.) — have already reached out to various winners, interviews with rumored 2028 hopefuls and newly elected Democrats reveal.

Incoming Reps. Nancy Lacore (D-S.C.) and Teresa Benitez-Thompson (D-Nev.), incoming Sens. Abdul El-Sayed in Michigan, Chris Pappas in New Hampshire and Annie Andrews in South Carolina, and New Mexico Gov.-elect Deb Haaland all got calls.

The outreach signals a desire among Democrats who surfed a massive blue wave to victory last week to leverage those wins and influence the coming presidential contest, both in key early primary states and battlegrounds.
"Lots of congratulatory calls with 'we would like to have conversations soon,'" said Morgan Jackson, a senior adviser to Sen.-elect Roy Cooper in North Carolina.

Some newly elected Democrats are openly positioning themselves as kingmakers on the road to 2028, arguing their campaigns offer templates for the next crop of White House aspirants. Others are positioning themselves as ambassadors to their states.

El-Sayed wants his party's next presidential nominee to support passing progressive policies like Medicare for All — and told POLITICO he hopes they’ll agree with his unflinching criticism of U.S. military support for Israel. Incoming Michigan Rep. William Lawrence said that Democrats won a “clear mandate” to take on Big Tech, including data centers , and to prevent endless wars, and he wants those issues to stay on “top of the agenda for 2028.” Haaland told POLITICO ahead of Election Day she wants Democrats to "have a plan for Indian tribes."

Their rise will influence the potential 2028 field’s ability to navigate new geography and new demands while courting established kingmakers and party leaders. And some warning signs are already emerging: Allies of Texas governor-elect Gina Hinojosa's are knives out for Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear , who they argue didn't do enough to help her as chair of the Democratic Governors Association and doesn't understand the power of Latino voters — a necessary component of any 2028 bid.
No state will be as central as South Carolina, which will go first on Democrats' presidential primary calendar and where the bench of candidates will be deepest.

Longtime Democratic Rep. Jim Clyburn (S.C.) is still expected to reprise his role as the host and kingmaker . But Andrews’ and Lacore’s massive upsets last Tuesday have supercharged Democrats’ delegation in the state.

Andrews has fielded multiple calls from potential presidential candidates since Election Day, according to a person with direct knowledge of her conversations. Lacore, too, has taken “many” congratulatory calls from potential Democratic candidates, per another person with direct knowledge. Sens. Raphael Warnock of Georgia and Kelly both campaigned for Andrews during the race, and Buttigieg and Beshear made appearances with Lacore in her coastal district.

Clyburn has long been vocal about the direction of the Democratic Party, active on the trail and open with his endorsements and advice to presidential hopefuls — and just recently with POLITICO . It’s not clear how the two newcomers will seek to shape 2028: Representatives for both campaigns declined to comment.

But Andrews, a pediatrician, made health care a central part of her campaign. And Lacore’s focus on veterans’ issues and national security could bring those to the forefront. The two of them and Clyburn are set to meet on Capitol Hill for the first time as South Carolina’s incoming delegation on Wednesday to plan how best to work together in Congress, according to a person familiar with the gathering.
Antjuan Seawright, a Clyburn adviser and Democratic strategist, said the three Palmetto State Democrats will likely have “different” approaches to their involvement in the 2028 primary.

“The three of them, individually and collectively, will have a tremendous opportunity to entertain and introduce South Carolina to the potential candidates who are seeking the office,” Seawright said.

New Hampshire’s elected Democrats have long wielded outsize influence over the party’s nominating process in what was the first-in-the-nation primary state. Pappas, a four-term representative, and Rep.-elect Stefany Shaheen, the daughter of two longtime New Hampshire Democratic power players, are well steeped in 2028 after multiple potential candidates campaigned with them through the fall to gain footholds in the state.
Pappas started signaling his status as a power broker in the final days of the election, and was on Kelly’s list of election-night phone calls.

“We had a lot of visitors at the end of this campaign, maybe some folks who were just using me as an excuse to come visit New Hampshire and kick the tires a little bit,” Pappas said on WMUR in a post-election interview.

Pappas told POLITICO on Monday he would “certainly” serve as an ambassador for candidates — and suggested there are “people who want to certainly come back soon. I think it’s going to kick off pretty quickly.”

Jim Demers, a veteran Democratic strategist and liaison for presidential hopefuls in the state, told POLITICO he believes both Pappas and Shaheen could serve as key conduits for candidates looking to play in New Hampshire.
body_zh: 2028 年总统竞选已经在一批新的民主党权力掮客的短信和电话中上演。
对传闻中的 2028 年候选人和新当选的民主党人的采访显示，一些潜在的白宫竞争者——包括前交通部长皮特·布蒂吉格、伊利诺伊州州长 JB Pritzker、马里兰州州长韦斯·摩尔、前大使拉姆·伊曼纽尔和参议员马克·凯利（亚利桑那州民主党）以及科里·布克（新泽西州民主党）——已经与各种获胜者进行了接触。
即将上任的众议员南希·拉科雷（南卡罗来纳州民主党）和特雷莎·贝尼特斯·汤普森（内华达州民主党）、即将上任的密歇根州参议员阿卜杜勒·埃尔·赛义德、新罕布什尔州的克里斯·帕帕斯和南卡罗来纳州的安妮·安德鲁斯，以及新墨西哥州当选州长德布·哈兰德都接到了电话。
此次外展活动表明，民主党人希望利用这些胜利并影响即将到来的总统竞选，无论是在关键的早期初选州还是战场上。
北卡罗来纳州当选参议员罗伊·库珀的高级顾问摩根·杰克逊表示，“很多人打来祝贺电话，表示‘我们希望尽快进行对话’。”
一些新当选的民主党人公开将自己定位为通往 2028 年道路上的拥护者，他们认为他们的竞选活动为下一代入主白宫的人提供了模板。其他人则将自己定位为驻各自国家的大使。

埃尔-赛义德希望他的政党的下一任总统候选人支持通过全民医疗保险等进步政策，并告诉《政治》杂志，他希望他们会同意他对美国军事支持以色列的坚定批评。即将上任的密歇根州众议员威廉·劳伦斯 (William Lawrence) 表示，民主党赢得了“明确授权”，可以挑战包括数据中心在内的大型科技公司，并防止无休止的战争，他希望这些问题继续成为“2028 年议程的首要议题”。哈兰德在选举日之前告诉《政治》杂志，她希望民主党“为印第安部落制定一个计划”。
他们的崛起将影响潜在的 2028 年领域驾驭新地理和新需求的能力，同时吸引老牌拥护者和政党领导人。一些警告信号已经出现：德克萨斯州当选州长吉娜·伊诺霍萨的盟友对肯塔基州州长安迪·贝希尔表示不满，他们认为贝希尔没有为她担任民主党州长协会主席提供足够的帮助，而且不了解拉丁裔选民的力量——这是任何2028年竞选的必要组成部分。
没有哪个州能像南卡罗来纳州那样处于核心地位，南卡罗来纳州将在民主党总统初选日程上排在第一位，而且候选人的板凳深度也将是最深的。
长期担任民主党众议员的吉姆·克莱伯恩（南卡罗来纳州）仍有望再次担任主持人和拥护者的角色。但安德鲁斯和拉科雷上周二的巨大不满让该州的民主党代表团变得更加强大。
据一位直接了解安德鲁斯谈话内容的人士透露，自选举日以来，安德鲁斯已多次接到潜在总统候选人的电话。据另一位直接知情人士透露，拉科雷也接到了潜在民主党候选人的“许多”祝贺电话。佐治亚州参议员拉斐尔·沃诺克和凯利都在竞选期间为安德鲁斯竞选，布蒂吉格和贝希尔与拉科雷一起出现在她的沿海地区。
克莱伯恩长期以来一直对民主党的方向直言不讳，积极参与其中，并向总统候选人公开表示支持和建议——最近还与《政治》杂志合作。目前尚不清楚这两位新人将如何塑造 2028 年：两个竞选团队的代表均拒绝置评。
但儿科医生安德鲁斯将医疗保健作为她竞选活动的核心部分。拉科雷对退伍军人问题和国家安全的关注可能会将这些问题带到最前沿。据一位知情人士透露，他们两人和克莱伯恩将于周三作为南卡罗来纳州即将上任的代表团在国会山首次会面，以计划如何在国会最好地合作。
克莱伯恩顾问兼民主党策略师安胡安·西赖特 (Antjuan Seawright) 表示，帕尔梅托州的三名民主党人可能会采取“不同”的方式参与 2028 年初选。
西赖特说：“他们三人，无论是个人还是集体，都将有巨大的机会招待南卡罗来纳州并向寻求该职位的潜在候选人介绍南卡罗来纳州。”
新罕布什尔州当选的民主党人长期以来对该党的提名过程发挥着巨大的影响力，这是全国第一个初选州。四届众议员帕帕斯和当选众议员斯蒂芬妮·沙欣（两位长期担任新罕布什尔州民主党权势人物的女儿）在多位潜在候选人秋季与他们一起竞选以在该州站稳脚跟后，两人在 2028 年的前景一片大好。
帕帕斯在选举的最后几天开始表明自己作为权力掮客的身份，并且出现在凯利选举之夜的电话名单上。
帕帕斯在选举后接受 WMUR 采访时说：“在竞选结束时，我们迎来了很多访客，也许有些人只是以我为借口来参观新罕布什尔州并踢一下轮胎。”
帕帕斯周一告诉《政治》杂志，他“肯定”会担任候选人的大使，并表示“有些人肯定希望很快回来。我认为这很快就会开始。”
资深民主党策略师、该州总统候选人的联络人吉姆·德默斯 (Jim Demers) 告诉《政治》杂志，他相信帕帕斯和沙欣都可以成为希望在新罕布什尔州竞选的候选人的关键渠道。

title_en: Missing baby found alive buried in dog crate in South Carolina
title_zh: 南卡罗来纳州失踪婴儿被发现埋在狗笼里
summary: An 11-month-old baby boy who officials said was taken by his father on Monday was found buried alive in a dog crate Tuesday, a discovery a South Carolina sheriff called joyful.
summary_zh: 一名 11 个月大的男婴官方称周一被其父亲带走，周二被发现被活埋在狗笼中，这一发现是南卡罗来纳州的
body_en: An 11-month-old baby boy who officials said was taken by his father on Monday was found buried alive in a dog crate Tuesday, a discovery a South Carolina sheriff called joyful.
Koah Sharpe was discovered alive in a dog crate wrapped in a towel, Lexington County Sheriff Bryan Koon told reporters.
“That, by the grace of God, probably provided enough air for him to survive — our estimation is, for the last 24 hours under that dirt,” he said.
Koah, described as a 20-pound boy with reddish hair and who had a pacifier, was taken by his father, Michael Comer, on Monday, the sheriff’s office said.
The crate was found buried around 1:30 p.m. Tuesday, Koon said, near the home of Comer’s father.
Comer was arrested late Monday in Lexington County on a burglary charge after he was found in an outbuilding, but the baby was not with him, the sheriff’s office said.
On Monday, the boy was in the care of Comer’s mother, Comer came over, and the woman left to run an errand but another caregiver was on the way, Koon said.
“By the time the caregiver got there, Michael was gone and Koah was gone with him,” Koon said.
Deputies went to Comer’s father’s home around noon Monday and found the doors open and baby belongings in the house but no sign of Comer or the baby, Koon said.
The South Carolina Law Enforcement Division, the FBI and federal Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives were part of the search for the child.
A search party of nearly 100 police officers, firefighters and other officials looked for the boy, Koon said.
Searchers on Tuesday found a site not far from Comer’s father’s house, about 50 yards into some woods with freshly disturbed earth, Koon said.
“As they probed it and laid it out and started digging, you could hear little Koah crying,” the sheriff said. “So, as you can imagine, the race was on.”
The baby was taken to a hospital where he was being cared for Tuesday afternoon, Koon said. The sheriff said he hopes the child makes a full recovery.
“He was screaming at the top of his lungs, which is a good thing in the baby world, I would guess,” Koon said.
The crate, which was about 2 feet by 2 feet, was buried in a shallow hole, Koon said.
Wrapping the wire crate in a towel probably created an air pocket, he said.
Koon said authorities were working with the prosecutor’s office regarding charges.
It was not immediately clear if Comer had an attorney who could speak on his behalf. A phone number for Comer’s parents could not immediately be found Tuesday.
Koon said the cool weather may also have helped the baby’s chances of survival.
body_zh: 官员称，一名 11 个月大的男婴于周一被其父亲带走，周二被发现被活埋在狗笼中，南卡罗来纳州警长称这一发现令人高兴。
列克星敦县警长布莱恩·库恩 (Bryan Koon) 告诉记者，科亚·夏普 (Koah Sharpe) 被发现在一个裹着毛巾的狗笼里，还活着。
“感谢上帝的恩典，这可能为他提供了足够的空气来生存——我们估计，在过去的 24 小时里，他都在泥土下生存，”他说。
治安官办公室称，Koah 是一名 20 磅重的男孩，头发呈红色，带着奶嘴，周一被他的父亲迈克尔·科默 (Michael Comer) 带走。
下午 1 点 30 分左右，板条箱被发现埋在地下。周二，库恩说，地点在科默父亲的家附近。
治安官办公室称，科默周一晚在列克星敦县一栋附属建筑中被发现后，因入室盗窃罪被捕，但婴儿并不在他身边。
库恩说，周一，男孩由科默的母亲照顾，科默过来了，这名妇女离开去办事，但另一名护理人员正在路上。
“当护理人员到达那里时，迈克尔已经走了，科阿也跟着他走了，”库恩说。
库恩说，周一中午左右，警员们来到科默父亲的家中，发现门开着，屋内有婴儿物品，但没有科默或婴儿的踪迹。
南卡罗来纳州执法部门、联邦调查局和联邦烟酒枪械爆炸物局参与了对这名儿童的搜寻工作。
Koon 说，由近 100 名警察、消防员和其他官员组成的搜救队正在寻找这名男孩。
库恩说，搜索者周二在距离科默父亲的房子不远的地方发现了一个地点，距离树林约 50 码，泥土刚刚被扰动。
“当他们探测它、把它铺好并开始挖掘时，你可以听到小科阿的哭声，”警长说。 “所以，正如你想象的那样，比赛已经开始了。”
库恩说，周二下午，婴儿被送往医院接受治疗。治安官表示，他希望孩子能够完全康复。
“他用尽全力尖叫，我猜这对婴儿世界来说是一件好事，”库恩说。
Koon 说，这个板条箱长约 2 英尺 x 2 英尺，被埋在一个浅洞中。
他说，用毛巾包裹金属丝箱可能会产生气穴。
库恩说，当局正在与检察官办公室就指控进行合作。
目前尚不清楚科默是否有律师可以代表他发言。周二无法立即找到科默父母的电话号码。
库恩说，凉爽的天气也可能增加了婴儿的生存机会。
